lines: A group ride now waits for its session, then every rider starts at the same moment.
Before the start, the clock holds at zero, the video waits at its first frame, and the time left counts down.
At the session's time, read from the server's clock, the clock and the video start together on every screen.
Arrive after the start, and the ride picks up from the session's time, two minutes in.
The countdown and the warm-up ahead look the same on every screen.
What the tests prove: zero until the start, both starting together, and a late rider in step.
Telo Ride, from the Telo family, turns a smart bike at home into a game.
It pairs with the bike over Bluetooth, reads your power and sets resistance for every hill and interval.

lines.text: Two doors: Race, ride a map against your best-time ghost, bots or people; and Classes, ride along to a video, alone or with a group; fed by one progression of XP, rider levels, stars and map unlocks.
